undergraduate_programs: BS (Biochem, Biotech, Botany, Chemistry, CS, Criminology, Econ, Education, English, Geology, IT, Islamic Studies, Journalism, BBA, Commerce, Math, Physics, Pol Sci, Psych, SE, Social Work, Sociology, Urdu, Zoology), 5th Sem induction.
master_programs: MS/M.Phil (Biochem, Biotech, Botany, Chemistry, CS, Islamic Studies, Mgmt Sci, Math, Pashto, Physics, Pol Sci, Pharmacy, Sociology, Zoology, English).
PhD_programs: PhD in Science, Social Sciences, and Management disciplines.
admission_criteria: BS: Min 45% HSSC. PG: 2.5 CGPA (MS) / 3.0 CGPA (PhD). Selection: Academic merit for BS; Entry Test (50/60%) for PG.
application_process: Online via university portal. Processing at National Bank or Allied Bank. Deadlines: July/Sept.
scholarships: HEC Need-Based, KPEF Merit-cum-Inaffordability, SAFE Scholarship, Merit-based rewards.
entry_test: Written test + Interview for BS. GAT/Internal test (50/60% passing) for MS/PhD.

detailed_fee_structure.Note: Ideally located in Chakdara, serving the Malakand division with a focus on research and natural sciences.

location: Chakdara, Lower Dir, KPK, Pakistan.

university_name: University of Management and Technology (UMT) Lahore
undergraduate_programs: BS (CS, AI, SE, Data Sci, Electrical/Civil/Mech Eng, BBA, A&F, DPT, LLB, Architecture, Design & Textiles, Media, Food Science).
master_programs: MS/M.Phil (Business Admin, CS, AI, Mgmt, Engineering, Social Sciences, Law & Policy).
PhD_programs: PhD in Management, CS, Engineering, and Social Sciences.
admission_criteria: UG: Min 50% HSSC (45% for LLB + LAT). PG: Relevant degree + CGPA. Selection: Merit weighted by Academic (50-70%) + Test (30%).
application_process: Online via umt.edu.pk. Emphasizes AI-Powered Education. Flexible semester installments available.
scholarships: Over PKR 14B awarded; Merit-based (up to 100%), Need-based (ILM Fund), Alumni, Special Category (Disabled/Sports).
entry_test: UMT Admission Test mandatory (Min 50% score for most; 33% for Eng Tech).

detailed_fee_structure.Note: Premier private research university in Lahore with a strong focus on innovation and startup culture.

location: C-II, Johar Town, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan.

undergraduate_programs: BS (Chemistry, Electronics, BEMS, Food Tech, e-Commerce, IR, Botany, Aviation Mgmt, CS, IT, Stats, Econ, Criminology, Media, Physics, Special Ed).
master_programs: MS/M.Phil (Climate Change, Mgmt Sci, CS, Nanotech, Botany, Islamic Studies, Zoology, Sociology, Chemistry, Physics).
PhD_programs: PhD in Education and Chemistry.
admission_criteria: BS: Pass HSSC-I (can apply with 1st year marks). PG: 2.5 CGPA + 50% test score. PhD: 3.0 CGPA + 60% test score.
application_process: Online via admissions portal. Deadlines typically January for Spring and August for Fall.
scholarships: Orphan/Disabled support, PEEF, Chief Minister's Honhaar Scholarship, Minority quotes.
entry_test: Required for post-graduate programs and specific undergraduate disciplines (DPT, Engineering).

detailed_fee_structure.Note: Public university in central Punjab focusing on accessible higher education and community outreach.

location: 2-KM Main GT Road, Renala Khurd, Okara, Punjab, Pakistan.

undergraduate_programs: BS (Arts, Archaeology, History, Islamiyat, Pashto, Biotech, Botany, Geomatics, Geography, Journalism, LLB 5Y, CS, Robotics & Intelligent Systems).
master_programs: MS/M.Phil (Journalism, Pharmacy, Psychology, Electronics, Development Studies), PG Diplomas.
PhD_programs: PhD in wide range of Humanities, Social and Natural Sciences.
admission_criteria: BS: Merit based on Matric (Home Econ) or HSSC + ETEA scores. PG: 16Y education with 2.5 CGPA / 60% marks.
application_process: Online via uop.edu.pk. Deadlines: Jan/Feb for Spring, Nov for Fall. Provisional/Final merit lists posted online.
scholarships: HEC Need-Based, University Financial Aid, Various Provincial schemes.
entry_test: ETEA Entrance Test mandatory for undergraduate engineering/tech (held in Aug). Internal General Test (60% pass) for PG.

detailed_fee_structure.Note: The oldest and most prestigious public research university in KPK province.

location: Old Jamrud Road, Peshawar, KPK, Pakistan.

undergraduate_programs: BS (Agri, Environmental Sci, Forestry, HND, Forensic Sci, Biotech, Microbiology, Botany, Zoology, Biochem, Math, Physics, Chemistry, Geology, SE, CS, English, Psych, Sociology, Econ, BBA, Commerce, A&F, IR, LLB, B.Ed, Islamic Studies), Pharm-D, BEMS, MLT, Electrical Eng, DVM.
master_programs: MS/M.Phil (Islamic Studies, Mgmt Sciences, Math, Chemistry, Electrical Eng, CS, Physics, Botany, Zoology).
PhD_programs: PhD (Horticulture, Food Sciences, Plant Pathology, Agronomy, Entomology, Math, Electrical Eng, Chemistry, Mgmt Sci, Botany, CS, Islamic Studies, Physics, Zoology).
admission_criteria: UG: Min 45-65% HSSC (Agri requires 45%; some others higher). PG: Relevant degree with 2.5 CGPA + University Entry Test.
application_process: Online via upr.edu.pk or Physical submission at Admissions Office. Deadlines: Sept (Fall), March (Spring).
scholarships: Ehsaas, HEC Merit/Need-Based, HBL Platinum Scholarship, Student Welfare Fund.
entry_test: Mandatory Entry Test for all undergraduate and M.Phil/PhD programs (typically held in Sept for Fall).

detailed_fee_structure.Local vs International: Tuition fees vary significantly for foreign/refugee seats
detailed_fee_structure.Note: Established in 2011 to serve the educational needs of the Poonch division in AJK.

location: Rawalakot, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Pakistan.

undergraduate_programs: BS (CS, SE, IT, BBIS, Data Sci, BBA, Commerce, A&F, Banking & Finance, Chemistry, Math, Physics, Electronics, Stats, English, Psych, Criminology), LLB (5 Years).
master_programs: MS/M.Phil (Economics, English Linguistics, Physics, Clinical Psychology, Chemistry, Business Admin), LLM.
PhD_programs: PhD programs offered in selected Science and Humanities departments.
admission_criteria: UG: Min 45-50% HSSC. Selection: Merit-based (no test for BS except LAT for LLB). PG: Relevant degree + Entry Test + Interview.
application_process: Online registration via uosahiwal.edu.pk. Deadlines: July (Fall).
scholarships: Merit-based, HEC Need-Based, Ehsaas, Honhaar Scholarship, Ushar Zakat (from 2nd sem).
entry_test: Mandatory LAT for LLB. Graduate Entry Test (40% weight) for M.Phil/PhD. Most BS programs involve open merit.

detailed_fee_structure.Note: A relatively new public university rapidly expanding its technical and management science faculties.

location: Sahiwal, Punjab, Pakistan.

undergraduate_programs: BS (across 41 departments: CIT, Engineering, Agriculture, Medical/Health Sciences, Arts & Humanities, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences), BBA, BFA, LLB.
master_programs: MS/M.Phil/M.Sc (Hons) in Engineering, IT, Management, Agriculture, and basic sciences.
PhD_programs: PhD in over 30 disciplines (HAT General mandatory).
admission_criteria: UG: Min 3rd Div for Arts; 45-50% for Sciences/Tech. Max Age: 30 Years. PG: 2.5 CGPA + Entry Test (HAT for PhD).
application_process: Strictly Online via university portal. Manual forms not accepted. Deadlines: July (Fall), Dec (Spring).
scholarships: HEC Need-Based, Bait-ul-Mal, PEEF, Benazir Undergraduate Scholarship (BUSP), Kinship & Minority waivers.
entry_test: ECAT-UOS for Engineering; Sports/Hafiz-e-Quran/Medical tests for special seats. HAT for MS/PhD.

detailed_fee_structure.Note: Ranking among Top 5 public universities in Punjab for its academic and research output.

location: Sargodha, Punjab, Pakistan.

master_programs: MS/M.Phil (Biotech, Chemistry, CS, Econ, Education, Electrical Eng, Mgmt Sci, Math, Physics), MBA (Reg/Exec).
PhD_programs: PhD (Biotech, Chemistry, CS, EE, Education, Mgmt Sci, Physics).
admission_criteria: BS: Min 45% HSSC (60% for Eng). Selection: 40% Entry Test + 60% Academics. PG: Relevant degree + GAT score.
application_process: Online via portal. Deadlines: Aug (Fall), Feb (Spring). Interview mandatory for selection.
scholarships: Provisional Merit-based, HEC Need-Based, Provincial schemes.
entry_test: UAT-General (MS) / UAT-Subject (PhD) via Allied Testing Services (ATS). Specific Aptitude Test for Engineering.

detailed_fee_structure.Note: Strategic technical hub in southern KPK focusing on Applied Sciences and Engineering.

location: Main Campus, Bannu, KPK, Pakistan.

undergraduate_programs: BS (AI, CS, SE, Biotech, Math, Chemistry, BBA, DPT, Pharm-D, Fashion Design, Graphic Design), ADP programs.
master_programs: MS/M.Phil (Management Sciences, Biological Sci, Biotech, Chemistry, CS, English, IR, Islamic Studies).

admission_criteria: UG: Min 50% HSSC. PG: 2.5 CGPA + 50% test score (NTS or Internal). Selection: Academic Record for BS; Test + Academic for PG.

scholarships: Merit-based, Need-based, USKT Alumni, Orphan/Disabled waivers, Honhaar (Punjab Govt).
entry_test: Graduate Entry Test (60% passing for internal; 50% for GAT) mandatory for MS/PhD. BS relies on academic merit only.
application_fee: PKR 15,000 Admission Fee + PKR 15,000 Registration Fee.

undergraduate_programs: BE/BSc in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Systems Engineering. BS Computer Science, BS Software Engineering.
master_programs: ME/MS in specialized engineering fields (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), MS Computer Science, Engineering Management.
admission_criteria: Minimum 60% marks in FSc Pre-Engineering / DAE. Entrance Test is mandatory for all engineering degrees.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.

university_name: Ghazi National Institute of Engineering and Sciences, Dera Ghazi Khan
undergraduate_programs: BE/BSc in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Systems Engineering. BS Computer Science, BS Software Engineering.
master_programs: ME/MS in specialized engineering fields (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), MS Computer Science, Engineering Management.
admission_criteria: Minimum 60% marks in FSc Pre-Engineering / DAE. Entrance Test is mandatory for all engineering degrees.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.

university_name: Hands Institute of Development Studies, Karachi
undergraduate_programs: BS Computer Science, BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration), BS Accounting & Finance, BS English, BS Mathematics, BS Software Engineering, BS Information Technology, Various Arts & Humanities degrees.
master_programs: MS/M.Phil in Management Sciences, Computer Science, Mathematics, Educational Leadership, Islamic Studies. MBA Programs (Regular & Executive).
admission_criteria: Undergraduate: Minimum 45% - 50% marks in Intermediate (FA/FSc) or equivalent. Graduate: 16-years of education with minimum 2.0/4.0 CGPA or 50% aggregate.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.

ERP — A Landmark in Digital Transformation Microsoft for Students Scholarships QEC ORIC Lasbela University of Agriculture, Water and Marine Sciences (LUAWMS), located in the historic and magnificent district Lasbela in Balochistan province of Pakistan, is truly a comprehensive institution of higher education with enduring commitment to achieve excellence in higher education, innovative technology, cutting-edge research, and superior public service LUAWMS is dedicated to prepare its graduates for successful careers and enable them to play a constructive role in progressing social inclusion, economic prosperity, and environmental quality Vice Chancellor's Message Lasbela University of Agriculture, Water and Marine Sciences is a breeding ground for the skilled professionals, who are the dire need of Pakistan in general and Balochistan in particular, for utilizing the agricultural resources, conserving the water resources and exploiting the marine assets. The University is not just pouring the availing knowledge into the minds of students at B.S level but also equipping the students with the art of the making of knowledge itself at M.Phil and PhD level.... master_programs: So, the UoR despite being established very recently has a rich history and enviable legacy of producing engineering professionals for more than a century About Our University The legacy of the University of Rasul, Mandi Bahaud Din goes back to the year 1873 and finds its roots in the School of Surveying that was established at the University Oriental College in Lahore. The School of Surveying mentored well trained engineering workers for construction of buildings, roads, barrages and irrigation systems in the region.

undergraduate_programs: BS Computer Science, BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration), BS Accounting & Finance, BS English, BS Mathematics, BS Software Engineering, BS Information Technology, Various Arts & Humanities degrees.

admission_criteria: Undergraduate: Minimum 45% - 50% marks in Intermediate (FA/FSc) or equivalent. Graduate: 16-years of education with minimum 2.0/4.0 CGPA or 50% aggregate.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.

university_name: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Shaheed Benazirabad
undergraduate_programs: BS Computer Science, BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration), BS Accounting & Finance, BS English, BS Mathematics, BS Software Engineering, BS Information Technology, Various Arts & Humanities degrees.
master_programs: MS/M.Phil in Management Sciences, Computer Science, Mathematics, Educational Leadership, Islamic Studies. MBA Programs (Regular & Executive).
admission_criteria: Undergraduate: Minimum 45% - 50% marks in Intermediate (FA/FSc) or equivalent. Graduate: 16-years of education with minimum 2.0/4.0 CGPA or 50% aggregate.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.

university_name: Shuhada-e-Army Public School University of Technology, Nowshera
undergraduate_programs: BE/BSc in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Systems Engineering. BS Computer Science, BS Software Engineering.
master_programs: ME/MS in specialized engineering fields (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), MS Computer Science, Engineering Management.
admission_criteria: Minimum 60% marks in FSc Pre-Engineering / DAE. Entrance Test is mandatory for all engineering degrees.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.
location: Nowshehra, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

admission_criteria: Undergraduate: Minimum 45% - 50% marks in Intermediate (FA/FSc) or equivalent. Graduate: 16-years of education with minimum 2.0/4.0 CGPA or 50% aggregate.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.

university_name: The Sindh Institute of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, Karachi
undergraduate_programs: MBBS, BDS, Pharm-D, DPT (Doctor of Physical Therapy), BS Nursing, BS Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT), BS Public Health.
master_programs: M.Phil/MS in Basic Medical Sciences, FCPS/MD/MS post-graduate clinical training programs.
admission_criteria: Minimum 60% to 65% marks in FSc Pre-Medical. MDCAT test score is mandatory as per PMDC regulations.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.
location: Karachi, Sindh
contact_details: Sindh Institute of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, Opposite SIUT, Near Mujahid Masjid, Chand Bibi Road, South Karachi, Sindh – 74200 (021) 99216212-13-14

undergraduate_programs: BS Computer Science, BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration), BS Accounting & Finance, BS English, BS Mathematics, BS Software Engineering, BS Information Technology, Various Arts & Humanities degrees.
master_programs: MS/M.Phil in Management Sciences, Computer Science, Mathematics, Educational Leadership, Islamic Studies. MBA Programs (Regular & Executive).
admission_criteria: Undergraduate: Minimum 45% - 50% marks in Intermediate (FA/FSc) or equivalent. Graduate: 16-years of education with minimum 2.0/4.0 CGPA or 50% aggregate.
application_process: Apply via the official university online admission portal. Submit required documents (CNIC, transcripts, domicile) and pay the admission processing fee voucher at designated banks.
scholarships: Merit-based scholarships for position holders, Need-based financial assistance, HEC Need-Based Scholarships, and provincial endowment funds (PEEF/SEEF) where applicable.
entry_test: University's internal entry test is mandatory for most programs. Valid NTS NAT/GAT test scores or HEC-HAT may also be accepted.
